messages:
sam: quick idea — propose we trial staggered IC check-ins for postmortem action tracking. three light checkpoints (24h, 7d, 30d) instead of relying on ad-hoc followups. rotation of incident commander weekly so ownership doesn't stall. sketch below, want feedback before i PR to playbook.

maya: sounds useful. can we make the 24h check a required field in the PM template and wire an auto-reminder (ops-bot) to the owner? also recommend a 'recurrence flag' if the same component shows up >2 times in 90d.

jordan: +1. for customer-impact incidents i'd tighten cadence (12h, 3d, 14d). otherwise the 24/7/30 looks fine. also suggest we add a "no-change escalation" path if owner reports blocked twice.

lee: can we draft minimal templates for each checkpoint? i think short, actionable items only so people actually fill them. something like:

```
24h-check:
- Owner: <name>
- Status: In progress / Done / Blocked
- Blockers (if any): short bullets
- Next action & ETA: 1 line
- Escalate if no progress by: <timestamp>

7d-check:
- Owner: <name>
- Summary of changes since 24h: 1-2 bullets
- Risk to production: low/med/high
- Next action & ETA

30d-check:
- Owner: <name>
- Resolution verification: yes/no + evidence link
- Followup tasks (linked cards)
- Lessons / recurring patterns observed
```

ops-bot: noted — i can post scheduled reminders to the thread and ping the incident-owner on the 24h/7d/30d cadence. set via `@ops-bot schedule <thread_ts> 24h 7d 30d` (ops team will need to enable).

sam: good — for rotation i propose weekly swaps on monday 09:00 UTC. primary ic handles the first 30h of followups, secondary covers weekends. keep a 4-week visible roster in the playbook and calendar.

maya: +1 to monday swap. also recommend a quick 15-min weekly sync for active remediations only (max 6 items) so we detect patterns sooner.

jordan: can we add a metric to track "remediations reopened" and "repeat-component incidents" over 90d? put alert on >=3 repeats so we trigger a review.

sam: i'll draft a PR with the templates, rotation cadence, and a suggested ops-bot command set. @maya can you volunteer to be first-week IC and confirm ops-bot scheduling? :thumbsup:

maya: happy to take week 1. i'll also add the recurrence flag logic to the PM checklist.

lee: thanks. once sam PRs, i'd like a quick 30-min review with oncall leads to sanity-check wording and escalate rules.

sam: plan: i'll open PR by EOD, ops-bot scheduling pending ops enablement. if no objections by EOD tomorrow i'll merge and add calendar invites for the rotation.

jordan: no objections from me.

maya: none from me either.

ops-bot: reminder: use `@ops-bot help` for scheduling permissions and `@ops-bot status <thread_ts>` to view upcoming reminders.

sam: thanks all — this should cut down on orphaned action items and make recurrence detection faster.
